summary: Simulated Day 2 on tomorrow's real forecast (Mon 2 Nov): fog in Bilbao until about 10:00, then a cloudy coast with a chance of a shower near Zumaia and clear skies with light winds from San Sebastián to Hondarribia. yr.no for Zumaia and the Biarritz pages were stale and were discarded; AEMET was used, and Hondarribia stands in for Biarritz.

bal.text: Fog in Bilbao until about 10:00, so the 09:00 start on the N-634 coast road is in poor visibility; the cliff road itself is dry to showery with light wind. Take it slowly at first or leave around 10:00.

fast.text: Fog in Bilbao until about 10:00 on the AP-8; after that cloudy, mostly dry and light winds. Dipped lights and extra distance at first.

cine.text: Mostly dry; fog in Bilbao until about 10:00 means a slow, low-visibility start, then cloudy with a 50% chance of a shower on the Mutriku cliff road and clear, light winds on the Jaizkibel ridge (gusts under 20 km/h). Leave as planned with dipped lights, or start 30–60 minutes later to miss the fog.

safe.text: Fog in Bilbao until about 10:00 on the AP-8 inland; then dry and calm to Biarritz. Take it slowly at first.
